import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop, mouse
from PIL import Image

BASE=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer-known-folder-before")
EXE=BASE/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
aliases={
"Desktop":("Desktop","\ubc14\ud0d5 \ud654\uba74"),
"Documents":("Documents","\ubb38\uc11c"),
"Downloads":("Downloads","\ub2e4\uc6b4\ub85c\ub4dc"),
"Pictures":("Pictures","\uc0ac\uc9c4"),
"Music":("Music","\uc74c\uc545"),
"Videos":("Videos","\ub3d9\uc601\uc0c1"),
}
def until(fn,why,timeout=25):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.22)
    raise AssertionError(why)
def key_for_name(name):
    for key,names in aliases.items():
        if any(a in name for a in names):return key
    return None
def visible(container):
    out={}
    for row in container.descendants():
        if row.element_info.control_type!="ListItem":continue
        try:
            name=row.element_info.name or row.window_text()
            key=key_for_name(name)
            if not key:continue
            r=row.rectangle()
            if r.width()<=0 or r.height()<=0:continue
            images=[x.element_info.name for x in row.descendants()
                    if x.element_info.control_type=="Image"]
            out[key]=(name,images)
        except Exception:pass
    return out
def shot(w):
    img=w.capture_as_image().convert("RGB");img.thumbnail((972,720))
    b=io.BytesIO();img.save(b,format="JPEG",quality=86,optimize=True)
    return base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

owned=BASE/"logs"/"known-folder-before-owned"
if owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir();(owned/"temp").mkdir()

 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
 encoding="ascii",newline="")

env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata");env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
w=None
try:
    def getw():
        if p.poll() is not None:return None
        ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=p.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x.window_text()]

    w=until(getw,"before window missing")

    except Exception:pass
    files=until(lambda:next((x for x in w.descendants()

    r=files.rectangle();center=(r.left+max(20,r.width()//2),r.top+max(40,r.height()//2))
    seen={}
    for step in range(14):
        vis=visible(files)
        for key,val in vis.items():seen[key]=val
        if seen.keys()>=set(aliases):break
        mouse.scroll(coords=center,wheel_dist=-4);time.sleep(.45)
    print("BEFORE_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(set(aliases)&set(seen)),flush=True)
    generic=0
    for key in sorted(set(aliases)&set(seen)):
        names=seen[key][1]

        print("BEFORE_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",key,repr(seen[key]),flush=True)
    print("BEFORE_GENERIC_FOLDER_ICON_COUNT",generic,flush=True)

finally:

            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(w.handle,0x10,0,0)

        else:p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=8)
print("BEFORE_PROCESS_EXIT",p.returncode,flush=True)
